---
title: "Choose a Simulation"
description: "Choose a calculation by the physical quantity you need."
sidebar: simulation
---

Choose the question first, then open a tutorial with the matching geometry,
excitation, and backend.

| Question | Guide |
| --- | --- |
| What capacitance does this conductor arrangement have? | [Capacitance](simulation/requirements/electrostatic-capacitance.qmd) |
| What are the natural or loaded modes? | [Resonance & Eigenmodes](simulation/requirements/eigenmode.qmd) |
| How do signals reflect and transmit? | [S-parameters & Ports](simulation/requirements/driven-terminal.qmd) |
| What are the uniform-line parameters? | [Cross-section Simulation](simulation/requirements/q2d-cross-section.qmd) |
| Where is field energy stored, and how do interface assumptions affect loss? | [Participation & Surface Loss](simulation/requirements/epr-loss.qmd) |

::: {.callout-note}
Match the OrcaPen, SCGSim, and solver versions listed in each tutorial.
Version differences may require code adjustments.
:::
